# openinfra_backup_plan (Resource)

A backup schedule — one or more rules, each a cron schedule writing to a BackupVault. Compiles to Velero Schedules.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Resource name. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `rules` (Attributes List) One or more backup rules; each becomes a Velero Schedule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

### Optional

- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `selection` (Attributes) What to back up. Defaults to all namespaces excluding the system/backup ones. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--selection))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `namespace/name`, the import identifier.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the resource's Ready condition is True. Terraform returns as soon as the object is accepted, so this is usually `false` immediately after apply — the platform reconciles asynchronously.
- `schedule_count` (Number) Number of Velero Schedules this plan generated.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `name` (String) Rule name, unique within the plan (becomes part of the Schedule name).
- `schedule` (String) Cron schedule for this rule, e.g. "0 3 * * *" (daily at 03:00).
- `target_vault` (String) The BackupVault (by name) these backups are stored in.

Optional:

- `retention_days` (Number) How long to keep each backup from this rule, in days (Velero TTL). Defaults to 30.


<a id="nestedatt--selection"></a>
### Nested Schema for `selection`

Optional:

- `included_namespaces` (List of String) Namespaces to back up (default ["*"] — all, minus the system excludes).
- `included_resources` (List of String) Restrict to these resource types (default: all).
- `label_selector` (Map of String) Only back up objects matching these labels (matchLabels).
